name: hexy-ground-anatomy
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Transparent 4 columns by 3 rows sprite sheet, exactly TWELVE isolated FULL BODY drawings of Hexy. Reference is the corrected TWO-ARM master pose; retain exact character, youthful face, detailed anime cartoon rendering, outfit and readable anatomy. Each cel identical camera, similar proportions, large transparent gutters, NO overlap and complete hat, hair, wand star, feet. No text, background, motion echoes, aura or panels.
All twelve frames have exactly TWO continuous bent arms, TWO short sleeves, TWO visible separated elbows, TWO hands close to chest gripping the SAME wand. Wand tilts 45 degrees up-right. Screen-left shoulder -> sleeve -> upper arm down-left -> visible elbow at left waist -> forearm up-right -> lower hand at center chest. Screen-right shoulder -> sleeve -> upper arm down-right -> visible elbow right waist -> forearm up-left -> upper hand at center chest. Two elbows stay APART. No extended arm in front, no third arm, no extra hand, no crossed limbs. Do not move hands away from chest. Hair behind shoulders blows left.
Top row4cels: settling under huge pressure, gritted teeth, torso and arms brace. Middle row4cels: continued enormous effort, clenched teeth and sweat, wind and skirt/hair animate. Bottom row4cels: renewed resolve and louder final shout for second ultimate, BOTH hands stay on handle, fingers/shoulders/hair/cloth redraw subtly. Four real changing cels per row, never duplicate drawings.
Every frame GROUNDED: feet wide apart in a low braced stance, knees bent, boots firmly planted at same baseline, facing right as reference.
